name: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
layout: Formula 1 Grand Prix circuit through the Foro Sol stadium (2015-)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (ODbL, Overpass API), F1 stadium route chosen by best fit to the F1 live-timing circuit trace (MultiViewer API, rms ~7 m)
sources.width: Published/approximate: ~15 m main straight, 12-13 m elsewhere, ~12 m through the esses and stadium
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com, tile N19 W100), robust-median + smoothing; ~2,230-2,240 m
sources.pit: OpenStreetMap ways "Pit Lane" (638504647, 772763791) along the main straight
sources.corners: Official F1 turn numbering from F1 live-timing circuit data (MultiViewer API api.multiviewer.app/api/v1/circuits/65/2026) fitted to the centreline
sources.trim: Teams run maximum (Monaco-level) wings because the 2,240 m altitude air is ~22% thinner; actual downforce/drag delivered is lower
sources.pitLimit: F1 Sporting Regulations default 80 km/h (Mexico City GP event notes)
sources.pitLoss: F1 green-flag pit loss ~22.8 s from F1 live-timing derived circuit data (MultiViewer API)
sources.raceLaps: F1 2026 Mexico City GP: 71 laps; not a sprint weekend in 2026

notes: Clockwise. Start/finish line placed at the start gantry seen on Esri World Imagery (~870 m before the Turn 1 apex); the grid boxes painted further back may belong to the start procedure. Altitude ~2,240 m. The F1 layout leaves the Peraltada midway through the Foro Sol stadium; Turn 17 is the exit of the Peraltada.
